description: Implementation of quic_stream.cc, defining the QuicStream class and related functions for managing QUIC stream data, flow control, and stream state transitions.

classes.name: PendingStream
classes.description: Represents a pending QUIC stream with buffering and flow control management before full stream establishment.

classes.name: QuicStream
classes.description: Implements a QUIC stream, managing data transmission, flow control, and stream state transitions.

methods.name: PendingStream::OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming stream frames, updating flow control and stream state.

methods.name: PendingStream::OnRstStreamFrame
methods.description: Handles RST_STREAM frames, updating stream state and flow control.

methods.name: PendingStream::OnWindowUpdateFrame
methods.description: Handles WINDOW_UPDATE frames for flow control.

methods.name: QuicStream::OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Processes incoming stream frames, updating stream state and flow control.

methods.name: QuicStream::Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream with a specified error code.

methods.name: QuicStream::WriteOrBufferData
methods.description: Buffers or writes application data to the stream.

methods.name: QuicStream::CloseReadSide
methods.description: Closes the read side of the stream.

methods.name: QuicStream::CloseWriteSide
methods.description: Closes the write side of the stream.

methods.name: QuicStream::OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles connection closure affecting the stream.

methods.name: QuicStream::ResetWithError
methods.description: Resets the stream with a specific error.

methods.name: QuicStream::WriteBufferedData
methods.description: Writes buffered data to the network.
